ExtraBar 1.2.0 – Stability & Style Unleashed! 🎨⚡

✨ What's New & Improved

  • Auto Save: Every change you make is now saved automatically! Enjoy a faster, more reliable workflow without worrying about losing your customizations!
  • Enhanced Screens UI/UX: We've redesigned the screens experience with editable lists by default, improved sorting, and a smoother overall interface!
  • Live Bar Sync: Settings and item changes now sync instantly to your bar – no manual refresh needed! See your customizations update in real-time!
  • Colorful Widget Icons: Add a splash of personality! You can now set custom colors for each widget icon to match your style or brand!
  • Full Custom Icons Support: A brand new icon library tool for all apps and widgets! Upload icons from your Mac or download directly from a URL – unlimited customization awaits!
  • Three Floating Bar Sizes: Choose from small, medium, or large bar sizes in floating mode for improved accessibility and the perfect fit for your workflow!
  • Name on Hover: See app and item names when hovering or using keyboard navigation – easily toggleable in settings!

🔧 Technical Improvements

  • Stability Focus: This release is all about reliability! We've squashed bugs and optimized performance throughout the app!
  • Smoother Experience: Countless refinements under the hood for a snappier, more responsive ExtraBar!

🚀 What's Next?

We're continuing to polish and perfect ExtraBar based on your feedback! More customization options and exciting features are in development!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraBar community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make – keep it coming! 💙
